criterion: which general domain of assistant use the utterance belongs to

categories.name: Finance and Banking
categories.definition: User requests or inquiries related to personal financial accounts, credit/debit cards, bills, loans, investments, and currency exchange.

categories.name: Information Retrieval
categories.definition: User requests for general knowledge, definitions, facts, time, date, spelling, or language translation.

categories.name: Device and Assistant Management
categories.definition: User commands to control the assistant's settings, device functions, connectivity, or to manage ongoing processes.

categories.name: Travel and Navigation
categories.definition: User requests for travel planning, booking (flights, hotels, cars), directions, traffic information, ride-sharing, or travel-related information.

categories.name: Food and Dining
categories.definition: User requests for recipes, nutritional information, meal planning, food storage advice, or information/recommendations about restaurants.

categories.name: Automotive
categories.definition: User inquiries or tasks related to vehicle maintenance, performance information, or troubleshooting car issues.

categories.name: Calendar and Scheduling
categories.definition: User requests to manage appointments, events, or meetings on a calendar.

categories.name: Timers and Alarms
categories.definition: User commands to set, check, or manage timers and alarms.

categories.name: Shopping and List Management
categories.definition: User requests to track orders, manage shopping lists, or general to-do lists.

categories.name: Conversational and Social
categories.definition: User utterances for greetings, small talk, philosophical discussions, expressions of gratitude, or general feedback not tied to a specific task.

categories.name: Calculations and Conversions
categories.definition: User requests to perform mathematical operations or unit conversions.

categories.name: Assistant Persona and Customization
categories.definition: User questions about the assistant's identity or capabilities, or requests to customize the assistant's name or the user's name.

categories.name: Smart Home Control
categories.definition: User commands to control smart home devices or appliances.

categories.name: Booking and Reservations
categories.definition: User requests to make reservations for services, primarily restaurants, that are not related to travel.

categories.name: Weather
categories.definition: User inquiries about current or forecasted weather conditions.

categories.name: Media Control
categories.definition: User commands to play, pause, skip, identify, or manage media playback and playlists.

categories.name: Games and Simple Utilities
categories.definition: User requests for simple games, dice rolls, coin flips, or jokes.
